cues: Welcome to Class 12 Physics, Unit 7: Mechanical Waves.
This unit answers one question: what fixes the speed of sound?
The answer depends on just two properties of the medium, how stiff it is and how heavy it is, plus one subtle point about heat that took physics more than a century to get right.
